answer_1.quote: Automatic text simplification (ATS) aims to creates easier-to-read text while keeping the original meaning.
answer_1.outputs: simplified text from legal insurance documents

answer_2.quote: We normalize the outputs of the different systems by decimal scaling, so those whose outputs are in [0, 100] or [0, 1] all line up in a [0, 10] range.

answer_3.quote: JUDGEBERT, a new fine-tuned BERT metric de-signed to assess the legal meaning preservation between two French legal sentences, which we have trained to correlate with human judgment on French insurance text.
methods: fine-tuning on FrJUDGE with human annotations

answer_4.quote: We selected five native French-speaking law students at the Faculty of Law of University Laval as our annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assess simplicity level, characterization, and legal meaning preservation using a Likert scale from 1 to 10, with detailed annotation guidelines and training on 15 practice instances.
